name: Dense Pelt
description: 1️⃣A chunk of dense fur off of a beast or something.

name: Wisp Pelt
description:
2️⃣A pelt found under the ghastly aura of a wisp.
It is almost like touching a glowing bunny.

name: Bright Pelt
description:
3️⃣A vividly bright pelt of unnatural brightness and glory.
Was this monster you harvested this from a spawn from Dionysis or something?

name: Radiant Pelt
description:
4️⃣A gorgeous and shimmering pelt from a truly magnificent speciman.
Even the deities would be jealous of a mortal wearing something JAFTED from this.

name: Flowing Pelt
description:
5️⃣Even now that the beast you've scalped this off of is dead,
the fur of the pelt still almost looks like its flowing with some kind of ethereal wind.

name: Loose Spines
description: 1️⃣Some quills still on the pelt are barely hangin' in there.

name: Red Spines
description:
2️⃣The pelt is almost as red as the quills, but at least
the quills aren't falling out.

name: Sharp Spines
description:
3️⃣Still intact and almost functional, the quills on this pelt are
surprisingly sharp for being dead for who knows how long.

name: Crimson Spines
description:
4️⃣Crimson like the blood they will draw if you come anywhere fucking
near these spikey boiz.

name: Quantum Spines
description:
5️⃣The pelt this animal came off of requires a special carrying case
due to the fact that the spines can poke holes into another dimension.

name: Dead Branch
description:
1️⃣This is literally just a dead branch that some plant monster
probably dropped. Why did you pick it up?

name: Dry Branch
description:
2️⃣A branch that is a bit dry, but otherwise relatively sturdy.
It could probably be used for JAFTING in some way.

name: Preserved Branch
description:
3️⃣A branch that appears to have been preserved or something,
because it is definitely old, but still kinda firm.

name: Hard Branch
description:
4️⃣A branch that was hardened as though it was recently mined
out from a 74 layers deep archaeological dig.

name: Lark Branch
description:
5️⃣The branch at this point is not even really a branch, and also
somehow sings. This makes no sense, but you keep it anyway.

name: Broken Horn
description:
1️⃣The horn off of a deceased bull or minataur most likely.
Because you roughed 'em up, its horn is also broken.

name: Cracked Horn
description:
2️⃣A horn that is slightly cracked, likely from the concussive blow you left
the original owner with upon goring off their body.

name: Long Horn
description: 3️⃣A rather long horn, still intact surprisingly, and kinda sharp.

name: Demon Horn
description:
4️⃣A horn off a world-renowned demon that surely felt great shame when you ripped off
their only way of compensating for their size.

name: Regal Horn
description:
5️⃣A mighty horn glimmering and sparkling due to the studded gems.
Yes, you read that right: this is a diamond-encrusted horn.

name: Dead Greens
description:
1️⃣These greens were probably alive once, but they were trampled
all over, shit on, and half-digested. They are actually very gross.

name: Leafy Greens
description:
2️⃣A pile of leafy greens, petals, and other flora from the
bottom-most layer of a forest.

name: Bouncy Greens
description:
3️⃣Unusually bouncy greens that you plucked from somewhere that you maybe shouldn't have.
Why are they bouncing? The world will never know.

name: Fine Greens
description: 4️⃣A mighty fine bunch of green greens.

name: Verdant Greens
description: 5️⃣The most greenest of green greenery that you ever did green.

name: Cracked Stinger
description:
1️⃣The stinger of a fallen enemy. Cracked to all hell because you
find it difficult to show restraint against such pitiful mobs.

name: Intact Stinger
description:
2️⃣Not very different from the \Armor[326], except that it
isn't cracked.

name: Sharp Stinger
description: 3️⃣A very pointy and sharp stinger that will do sharp stinger things as-needed.

name: Offensive Stinger
description:
4️⃣A ruthless stinger you barely escaped with your life with after ripping off the ass of
one of those stupid ass bees. They deserved it though, I promise.

name: Live Stinger
description:
5️⃣It is as though this stinger has muscles built into it, as it is still writhing and
twitching. Is it alive?!

name: Odorless Powder
description:
1️⃣It isn't clear what this is, because it smells absolutely like nothing.
You probably should be cautious how you use this.

name: Odorful Powder
description:
2️⃣Now that it can be smelled, it is undecided as to which is worse:
being able to smell it, or not being able to smell it.

name: Ghastly Powder
description:
3️⃣A truly ghastly-smelling powder that you probably should not have picked up.
Why did you pick up a pile of this anyway? It is literal death.

name: Spectral Powder
description:
4️⃣This death powder- in addition to smelling rancid- also appears to be glowing
with the regret of 1000 wishes left unfulfilled.

name: Transparent Powder
description:
5️⃣This powder is not just hard to grasp, but also hard to see due to it being
almost entirely invisible... but the smell. Ohhhh the smell. Sweet fucking hell it is awful.

name: Worn Stone
description:
1️⃣Your average everyday stone. These things have a multitude of
uses, but you can do what you want with it.

name: Round Stone
description:
2️⃣This \Armor[336] has been extra worn, as it is starting to get kinda round
and smooth on the edges.

name: Circular Stone
description:
3️⃣Rather than becoming even more round, the stone became more disk-like actually.
How strange to find such abnormalities in nature.

name: Trapezoidal Stone
description:
4️⃣It is unclear why you are now picking up such obscure-shaped stones off the ground.
Though, they do appear to grant some degree of benefit in JAFTING.

name: Spherical Stone
description:
5️⃣A stone that is a perfect sphere. It probably isn't even a stone to be honest.
It is likely some kind of highly advanced artifact of a time long past.

name: Dry Coral
description:
1️⃣Coral is brutally sharp when dry, and also brutally fragile.
So be careful!

name: Gnarled Coral
description:
2️⃣A branch of really gnarly coral.
Like totally tubular dude!

name: River Coral
description:
3️⃣The kind of coral you probably see kappas holding onto for some unknown reason.
They must miss their rivers, and here you are farming them for their home's keepsakes.

name: Layered Coral
description:
4️⃣When coral grows a lot, it starts to layer upon itself.
It doesn't actually do this in any known science, but around here that seems to be the case.

name: Kapn Coral
description:
5️⃣The coral that literally is growing off of a kappa- that you just slayed.
How else will you JAFT awesome lucky things without this?

name: Scavenged Tail
description:
1️⃣The meat of this tail is almost entirely removed. It is barely possible to even
tell that this was a tail to begin with. Why did you pick it up?

name: Sinewy Tail
description:
2️⃣The tail from some kind of monster in the area.
The meat is absolutely worthless to cook with.

name: Beefy Tail
description:
3️⃣Do not mistake the name for this being a thick and juicy tail.
There appears to be actual beef(!!!) or beef-like meat on this tail left.

name: Thicc Tail
description: 4️⃣This tail has some serious oomph to it.

name: Dargin Tail
description:
5️⃣While the tail does have some sort of scales still attached, it is clear that you have
the means to penetrate the scales, so who cares? Itadakimasu!

name: Busted Talon
description:
1️⃣Even as busted as this talon is, its still very pointy and
can probably do some damage.

name: Dull Talon
description:
2️⃣A talon still intact, but rather dull. Still dangerous, but
not as dangerous as the ones still attached to the owner.

name: Hooked Talon
description:
3️⃣Dangerously hooked, this talon is fully intact and probably could cause
some damage if you tried to use it that way.

name: Serrated Talon
description:
4️⃣A talon with micro-serrations all across the talon. This is very deadly
to have produced intact, hopefully it was worth it.

name: Lethal Talon
description:
5️⃣A wildly deadly talon with edges, hooks, blades, dripping with poison,
glowing with otherworldly power... Who knows what you would use this for.

name: Detached Eyeball
description:
1️⃣The eye has been severed from its connective tissue that
is required for most uses, making this mostly useless.

name: Lacerated Eyeball
description:
2️⃣An eyeball of which has been gravely sliced from edge to edge.
Even if this was attached, which its not, it would not be of great use.

name: Snooping Eyeball
description:
3️⃣This eyeball does not appear to require a host, it floats about on its
own, but seems content to reside in your endless item sack.

name: Helicopter Eyeball
description:
4️⃣Instead of floating mysteriously, it just spins its connective tissue
around at insane speeds like a helicopter blade, forcing levitation.

name: Peerless Eyeball
description:
5️⃣This eye clearly is able to see through not only you, but also through
your family and friends and probably walls and clothing.

name: Flimsy Fangs
description:
1️⃣A pair of fangs that are so flimsy, they might actually be
made of jelly. Did you get this from a Jelli?

name: Bone Fangs
description:
2️⃣Due to the fact that these incisors are made of bone, it is
tough to determine whether they are teeth, or mandibles.

name: Double Fangs
description:
3️⃣A pair of fangs that are strong and capable of piercing flesh.
Obviously not yours, though, since you walk away the victor with them in-hand.

name: Powerful Fangs
description: 4️⃣A mighty set of fangs, likely from a dragon or maybe a wolf.

name: Razor Fangs
description:
5️⃣Extremely sharp fangs that are quite possibly the sharpest thing you've ever
obtained. Even your item sack is concerned about being sliced open from these.

name: Old Bone
description:
1️⃣The femur from a large animal- that must've been totally
obliterated based on how much is left of this bone.

name: Mossy Bone
description:
2️⃣A femur of some kind of humanoid that has long since been deceased.
It appears to be cracked beyond repair.

name: Earthen Bone
description:
3️⃣A femur that likely came from a large feline of some sort.
It appears completely intact.

name: Petrified Bone
description:
4️⃣A massive femur that could only have come from something equivalent to
a titan.

name: Spiral Bone
description:
5️⃣It is unclear what entity this femur belongs to, as it is completely intact
but also kind of elastic.

name: Dried Blood
description:
1️⃣Some kind of animal blood that has been dried for a while.
This is the result of a bit of rain loosening it so you can pick it up.

name: Coagulated Blood
description:
2️⃣After bleeding a while, blood will start to coagulate and get thick.
This is that blood, its actually kinda gross that you picked this off some beast.

name: Virgin Blood
description:
3️⃣Probably not from an actual virgin, but instead from one of those harpies
that are called "virgins" up in the mountains.

name: Sinister Blood
description:
4️⃣This is some really evil-looking blood. Why did you pick it up?
It is probably haunted or something.

name: Blue Blood
description:
5️⃣The finest of fine things across the land- blue blood.
Only the royalest of royals carry this blood.

name: Loose Scales
description:
1️⃣These scales are still attached to a membrane, but some are
actually starting to fall off.

name: Lizard Scales
description:
2️⃣These appear to be associated with some sort of lizard, but
after you fully destroyed the original owner, its tough to remember.

name: Enduring Scales
description:
3️⃣Some rather durable scales off a dragon or something otherwise that is
identifiable as "durable".

name: Wurm Scales
description:
4️⃣The scales off of a wurm deep deep in the subterranean depths.
The scales are difficult to see due to their inexplicable absorption of light.

name: Dargin Scales
description:
5️⃣The mightiest of mighty, scales off a dargin have all sorts of benefits,
including the ability to avoid crits.

name: Tough Root
description:
1️⃣This root is outrageously durable for how withered and busted
it looks.

name: Sprouting Root
description:
2️⃣A root that is sprouting little tendrils out, though they appear
to be extensions of the root rather than flowers.

name: Petrified Root
description:
3️⃣A root that has been petrified in some kind of stone for likely millenia.
The durability it boasts can be used for a variety of purposes.

name: Deep Root
description:
4️⃣A root that is rather long, clearly one that ran deep deep into
the ground. Perhaps you should put it back so it can grow more?

name: Infinity Root
description:
5️⃣The root of the ages, reaching through both dirt and the spacetime continuum.
Legends say it eventually reaches back to itself through dimensions.

name: Bearcat Flank
description:
1️⃣Bearcat meat is well-known for being terrible in flavor, gamey as all hell,
and like chewing through leather at any temp of cook.

name: Ripped Flank
description:
2️⃣The flank of a beast that looks like its been ripped off-
probably with bare hands- from the animal it once resided on.

name: Grim Flank
description:
3️⃣When it comes to premium flank cuts, you always look to the Grim.
Though the Grim can be tough to hunt, its flank is worth its weight in G.

name: Volt Jelli Flank
description:
4️⃣The volt jelli is a fiercesome jelli, but its flank will melt in your mouth.
The Raevula population is kept in check by deaths from attempting to hunt these beach demons.

name: Gigacat Flank
description:
5️⃣Of course the finest flank is none other than the gigacat's flank.
Lean, but due to its apex predator status, has the finest choice of prey to give it that perfect marbling.

name: Imp Tongue
description:
1️⃣An imp's tongue is most commonly used in a variety of
witch's tinctures. Their sense of taste supposedly makes brews taste better.

name: Goblin Tongue
description:
2️⃣The counterfeit alternative to \Item[391]s are obviously the super common
goblin tongues. Nevermind that goblins don't exist in this game.

name: Froggo Tongue
description:
3️⃣The tongue of a froggo is notoriously long and elastic. You could probably
use this in alchemy or something to JAFT the finest potions.

name: Dying Tongue
description:
4️⃣The tongue of a since-passed scholar, but you decided it would be somehow
more beneficial to rip the tongue out and use it for JAFTING.

name: Sinister Tongue
description:
5️⃣The emptiness radiates strongly off of this tongue. Clearly the most
maleficant of words not even an M-rated game would permit to be written in this text box were spoken with it.

name: Boney Ribs
description:
1️⃣Though the ribs and rib meat all look intact, the animal you
chose to destroy to get these ribs must've been nearly starved.

name: Lamia Ribs
description:
2️⃣The ribs of a super long lamia.
As a result, there are a fuckton of them.

name: Serpent Ribs
description:
3️⃣The serpent's ribs are usually kind of flexible due to the need to
constantly be wriggling.

name: Moosnake Ribs
description:
4️⃣The need to combine bovine and serpent resulted in the "moosnake".
It is unknown why this was created, but tastes kinda like hamburger.

name: Ouroboros Ribs
description:
5️⃣Eternally self-consuming ribs that make no sense.
Just accept that they are top-tier and probably used to JAFT some really nice things.

name: Big Gelatin
description:
1️⃣Slime monsters keep it all together with the power of science!
And also gelatin.

name: Large Gelatin
description: 2️⃣You must've plucked this glob from a rather large slime, because this is also rather large.

name: Huge Gelatin
description:
3️⃣A huge ass glob of gelatin probably carved from a kingly slime or something.
It strangely has no smell.

name: Massive Gelatin
description:
4️⃣A truly massive speciman of a slime.
It is unclear how you are keeping this in your bag, much less multiple of them.

name: Colossal Gelatin
description:
5️⃣This slime glob is actually bigger than you.
Do not question logic, just collect as many as possible, they must be important.

name: Inert Veil
description:
1️⃣The veil of the dead keeps ghosts at bay... or so the legend goes.
Really we just wanted something from the ghostys.

name: Dead Veil
description:
1️⃣The veil of the dead keeps ghosts at bay... or so the legend goes.
Really we just wanted something from the ghostys.

name: Expired Veil
description:
1️⃣The veil of the dead keeps ghosts at bay... or so the legend goes.
Really we just wanted something from the ghostys.

name: Perished Veil
description:
1️⃣The veil of the dead keeps ghosts at bay... or so the legend goes.
Really we just wanted something from the ghostys.

name: Wasted Veil
description:
1️⃣The veil of the dead keeps ghosts at bay... or so the legend goes.
Really we just wanted something from the ghostys.

name: Animal Heart
description:
1️⃣This is pretty gross to actually carry around, much less carry multiple around.
It is bloody, wet, squishy, and is starting to smell bad.

name: Beast Heart
description:
2️⃣The heart of your foes serves as a fine prize for their defeat.
There are probably other uses, beyond holding it proudly.

name: Hydro Heart
description:
3️⃣A heart from the aquatic sort are strange and more core-like or something.
It is certainly pulsing still; you should probably store it while it still can exist outside of water.

name: Titan Heart
description:
4️⃣Giant hearts are just massive and extremely heavy. Carrying more than one of these,
in your item sack no less, is a truly legendary feat to its own, nevermind defeating them for this.

name: Dargin Heart
description:
5️⃣The old classic dargin heart never fails to let down. It is a massive and
cute dragon-shaped heart. Does that make sense? Not at all, but here we are.

name: Gross Slime
description:
1️⃣A large blob of green slime shit you scooped up from a slime.
You can't even eat it its so fucking gross looking and feeling.

name: Leftover Slime
description:
2️⃣This slime is pretty gross. It was leftover from one of the
countless slime monsters you've slain. Still sorta jiggly, though.

name: Slimy Slime
description:
3️⃣The ways in english of saying "this is gross" are countless.
But this slime is downright nasty, offending all 8 of your senses.

name: Putrid Slime
description:
4️⃣The power of smell offends you in ways you didn't think were possible.
This slime is both rancid to look at and smell- it is a mystery why you carry it still.

name: Ancient Slime
description:
5️⃣Today you learned that slime eventually will smell like nothing.
You just need to age it several thousand years first.

name: Damaged Wing
description:
1️⃣A wing from some kind of flying critter that has clearly been
damaged beyond repair.

name: Flappy Wing
description:
2️⃣A wing that is still flapping, despite you having removed it from its
original owner.

name: Glossy Wing
description:
3️⃣Likely from a faerie of some kind, this wing is almost glossy in
its appearance due to a toxin the wing's pores emit in self-defense.

name: Double Wing
description:
4️⃣A large wing that appears to be actually two wings that work
together to accomplish flight. This monster must've grown two wings from one joint.

name: Iridescent Wing
description:
5️⃣A perfectly intact wing that sparkles all colors of the rainbow.
It smells faintly of potatoes.

name: Smelly Fish
description:
1️⃣It appears to be a standard freshwater cod.
Unfortunately, it is well past its prime and will likely be questionable in taste when cooked.

name: Ordinary Fish
description: 2️⃣A regular trout that probably lived in some nearby lake.

name: Fresh Fish
description:
3️⃣A giant bass that likely was found in some nearby river.
Its scales glisten in the sunlight- probably because its still wet.

name: Sparkling Fish
description:
4️⃣When salmon are grown in saltwater, their skin gets tougher, but
the flesh tastes even more delicious.

name: Pristine Fish
description:
5️⃣An entire tuna that has must've come from the ocean.
It is colossal, and a mystery how you are storing this in your item sack, much less likely multiples.

name: Faerie Petal
description:
1️⃣Most would believe these are the wings of a faerie, but really it
is a petal- literally a flake from their flesh.

name: Faerie Bud
description:
2️⃣The bud of a faerie is basically just a premature bit of the faerie
that you really shouldn't be harvesting, you monster.

name: Faerie Flower
description:
3️⃣The flower of a faerie is available any time after the faerie has
reached adulthood, but only a small window is available for the blossom...

name: Faerie Blossom
description:
4️⃣A beautiful blossom of a faerie. This only becomes available
when the faeries are at peak maturity.

name: Faerie Bouquet
description:
5️⃣The bouquet is just five dozen faerie blossoms. Why in the world would
anyone need this?

name: Bug Eggs
description:
1️⃣They are wiggling, slimy, and extra tiny. These are quite possibly
the grossest thing you've carried around on purpose.

name: Critter Eggs
description:
2️⃣Tiny critters like raccoons or squirrels are known to emerge from them
in this land.

name: Avian Eggs
description:
3️⃣The classic of classic, eggs from a bird.
You can use these for all sorts of fine cookery.

name: Froggo Eggs
description:
4️⃣The eggs from a froggo are much like what you recall coming from regular frogs.
Tadpoles come from these if left unattended, so attend them!

name: Ghosty Eggs
description:
5️⃣Did you think ghostys around here were the spirits of the dead?
They are living creatures just like you and me, but cute and spooky.

name: Waxxy Ear
description:
1️⃣The ear from some kind of humanoid. Often fashioned into a very
stylish necklace in certain cultures, but this one is just waxxy and gross.

name: Pierced Ear
description:
2️⃣An ear that has been pierced a few times. In some cultures, it is normal to do that.
In others, it is just inefficient, and thus the pierced-ear-bearers are exterminated.

name: Complete Ear
description:
3️⃣One whole and complete ear.
It almost looks kinda like yours.

name: Bandit's Ear
description:
4️⃣When the bandit first approached you, you decided instead of listening that
just chopping their ear off was a better opening statement.

name: Lord's Ear
description: 5️⃣The ear of the lordiest lord in all the land.

name: Wolftrap Vine
description:
1️⃣One of the 8 vines a wolftrap possesses. The plant has a ton of great
nutritional benefits, but is best known for restoring mental accuity.

name: Bloodtrap Vine
description:
2️⃣One of the 8 vines a bloodtrap possesses. Contrary to the
wolftrap, many of the components of a bloodtrap are mostly toxic.

name: Subtrap Vine
description:
3️⃣A vine from one of the 4 vines a subtrap possesses. Its vines are extremely elastic
and could probably be used as a rope if you really wanted.

name: Voidtrap Vine
description:
3️⃣A vine from one of the 6 vines a voidtrap possesses. Its vines are deadly
due to their matter-displacement-on-contact molecular reaction.

name: Doomtrap Vine
description:
5️⃣The vine from one of the deadliest flora known on this planet.
Just by keeping it in your item sack, it is trying to shift your fate towards doom.

name: Faded Core
description:
1️⃣The core of some sort of energy-based being.
Except that its completely faded and looks not far off from a regular rock.

name: Dimmed Core
description:
2️⃣A magical core that still glows faintly, but really can't deliver a lot.
Maybe you can charge it somehow?

name: Magic Core
description:
3️⃣The official core of a magic entity that derives its power from raw energy.
This is basically their battery, and you stole it from them.

name: Pulsating Core
description:
4️⃣A core still brimming with the energy of the enemy you just ripped it from.
It could probably power a lot of things!

name: Radiant Core
description:
5️⃣A brilliantly glowing core, overflowing with an abundance of energy!
Probably has equivalent energy output to a star going supernova.
